summary: The w6 headline problem is gone. The header band (jBand #656b73) now renders at 1.14-1.42x the back fabric (q10 92/80, q06 90/69, q08 105/74), against 0.86-1.35x in the photos (c_27312 0.86, tpg_42 0.92, omaat_room_15 1.11, c_27315 1.35). The flap (jHead #737b85) is at 1.27x in q10 and 1.6x in q08, against photos at 0.88-1.37x, so it is acceptable but still on the light side. In q06 the seat colours now track c_27312 closely: ash L164 vs 165, shell 87 vs 79, band 90 vs 83, fabric 69 vs 73-96. The remaining colour error is a cool cast on the charcoal parts (B-R +18..+23 vs +5..+9 in the photo). That cast comes from the lighting, because the shell material itself is only +11. The boarding bundle is back and sits correctly, with the blue duvet in plastic on top of the white pad, as in tpg_42, tpg_31 and the new omaat_room_15. (The w6 raters' suggestion to put the white pad on top was wrong; the implementer was right to follow the photos.) The pillow set is now the weakest thing in seat mode. (1) The blue pillow renders as a pale periwinkle that is brighter than the sofa: pillow/back 1.34 and pillow/bench 1.18 in q08, against 0.58-1.0 and 0.70-0.80 in tpg_42 and omaat_room_15. In every real photo it is a deep royal-blue checked jacquard with a grey flange, darker than the seat. (2) The white pillow's top sits level with the blue one's, so it reads as a white tray or frame. In the photos it stands 8-10 cm proud and offset toward the aisle. (3) The slipper pack is an opaque, glossy, bright-blue soap bar. Bed mode is unchanged and still a stiff slab: the wrinkles don't show, the head strip reads as a box, and the edges are straight (tpg_72 shows a rumpled, diagonal-edged comforter). The centre divider is still a broad flat charcoal spine (c_27313: slim twin fins). A shell strip about 5 cm deep sits above every monitor; tpg_53 and c_27316 show the monitor frame running to the monument top. Note: the uncommitted back piping in 09c_room.js (mtime 14:14) is newer than every render (14:06-14:12), so it was not judged.

issues.detail: Blue pillow is a pale periwinkle, brighter than the sofa; the photos show a deep royal-blue checked jacquard darker than the seat
issues.problem: The rendered pillow is #555f9d (L99, q08), which gives pillow/back fabric 1.34 and pillow/bench 1.18. The photos are #3b55aa in tpg_42 (pillow/back 0.58) and #5f649a in omaat_room_15 (mean over the light and dark checks, pillow/bench 0.80); official c_27302/27303 are #32355d-#3e457b. In studio (r7, b1, b2) the pillow reads lavender. The check pattern is faint, while the real one is a bold ichimatsu checkerboard. The real pillow also has a ~15 mm grey flange or piping all round (omaat_room_15, tpg_72), which the model lacks. In q08 and q09 it is the most eye-catching wrong colour in the seat.
issues.evidence: q08 pillow #555f9d L99 vs back #494853 L74; tpg_42 pillow #3b55aa L87 vs back L151; omaat_room_15 pillow L105 vs bench L132
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one key): SEATMAT.pillowBlue c '#5f6596' -> '#3c4690' (only 09c_room.js uses it). Target rendered pillow/bench 0.75-0.85. In 09c_room.js roomPillow, add a flange ring: B.add(gRBox(0.46, 0.012, 0.36, 0.012, 1), xf, { c: '#8a8c90', r: 0.6 }), drawn before the loft so only the 1 cm rim shows past the 0.44 x 0.34 cushion. If the yagasuri layer contrast is in LAYER_PARAMS, raise it ~1.5x so the checks read at q08 distance.

issues.detail: Bed duvet is still a stiff flat slab (carried over from w6, not addressed)
issues.problem: r6: the duvet is a uniform flat rectangle with a straight perimeter. The turn-down strip reads as a separate box and the wrinkle cylinders do not show. tpg_72 shows a soft rumpled comforter with large quilt puffs, a diagonal edge hanging toward the foot, and the pillow the same blue as the duvet.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomDuvet: delete the head-strip gRBox. Make the wrinkles visible: gCyl(0.02, 0.02, W*0.7, 10) at y + 0.006 (top of plateau + 6 mm), scale (1, 0.45, 1) so they read as broad soft ridges, 4-5 of them at irregular angles (+/-0.3 rad). Break the straight foot edge by adding a rotated (0.35 rad) gLoft(cushionSecs(W*0.6, 0.35, 0.02, -0.01, {edge:0.05,r:0.03})) overhanging the foot corner on the aisle side. Increase the loft crown to 0.012 with 3 lofts of differing W (quilt puffs) or bake a puff pattern into the duvet layer.

issues.detail: White pillow sits level behind the blue one and reads as a white frame
issues.problem: In O, the white pillow's top is at 0.63 + 0.17*sin74 = 0.79 and the blue one's at 0.64 + 0.17*sin60 = 0.79, so the white shows only as a rim on the top and sides (q08, b1, b2). It is also a hard rounded slab. In omaat_room_15, tpg_42 and tpg_31 it stands upright, with its top 8-10 cm above the blue pillow and offset about 6 cm toward the aisle, and it has soft dented corners.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomPart O: white pillow M4.trs(0.06, 0.63, -1.10, PI) -> M4.trs(0.12, 0.70, -1.12, PI) with tilt -78 deg. E: M4.trs(0.10, 0.62, 1.10) -> M4.trs(0.04, 0.69, 1.12), tilt -76 deg (offset toward the column side, away from the flap). cushionSecs edge 0.04 -> 0.06 and crown 0.03 for a puffier pillow.

issues.detail: Slipper pack is an opaque glossy bright-blue bar
issues.problem: roomBundle's 0.09 x 0.035 x 0.17 gRBox in '#1f4fb4' with r 0.3 reads as a soap bar or phone. In tpg_42 it is a blue pouch inside a crinkled clear bag with a silver bag beside it; in omaat_room_15 it is a dark navy pouch with a white tab.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomBundle: make it flatter and softer, gLoft(cushionSecs(0.10, 0.18, 0.025, -0.012, {edge:0.02, r:0.015}), 3) in { c: '#1d3f9a', r: 0.55 }, plus a slightly larger translucent-looking film gRBox(0.115, 0.03, 0.20, 0.012, 1) in { c: '#c9ced6', r: 0.12 } offset 0.03 toward the seat front so a silver bag edge shows.

issues.detail: Bundle sits ~0.15 m behind the cushion front; the photos show it near the front edge
issues.problem: Bundle centre z -0.93 (O) with depth 0.31, so the front edge is at -0.775 while the cushion front is at -0.63. In tpg_42 and omaat_room_15 the folded bundle reaches to within 3-8 cm of the cushion edge, with the blue pillow resting on its rear half.
issues.fix: 09c_room.js roomPart: roomBundle(B, 0.07, -0.93, 1, -1) -> roomBundle(B, 0.07, -0.86, 1, -1), and E roomBundle(B, 0.15, 0.93, -1, 1) -> (B, 0.15, 0.86, -1, 1). Leave the pillows where they are, so they sit on its rear half.

issues.detail: A charcoal strip ~5 cm deep sits above every monitor; in the photos the frame runs up to the monument top
issues.problem: The monitor frame top is 0.8475 + 0.2025 = 1.05, the cabinet top 1.09 and MON.top 1.10, so a 5 cm shell band plus cap shows above the monitor (q07: 27 px above a 238 px monitor). In tpg_53 the monitor frame top is about 1 cm below the cabinet top and there is no shell band above it. The monitor frame bottom also sits at the table top, not 1.5 cm below it.
issues.evidence: q07; tpg_53 (monitor frame y 143-470, cabinet 135-475); c_27316

issues.detail: Centre divider is still a broad flat charcoal spine (carried over from w5/w6)
issues.problem: q09 and r5 show a wide flat-topped wall between the centre pair. c_27313 shows two slim fins with light metal top edges and a dark gap between them.

Narrow the jCap rail to 0.02 per fin.

issues.detail: Ash grain is about half the photo contrast up close
issues.problem: High-pass SD of the ash is 2.5 % in q07 and 3.0 % in q09, against 4.7 % in c_27313, 7.4 % in c_27316 and 8.5-12.8 % in omaat_777j_13/14. Up close the ash reads as streaky white plaster rather than wood.
issues.fix: 03_tex.js (shared, one key): LAYER_PARAMS for layer 19 (J ash) contrast up ~1.6x. Keep the mean colour, SEATMAT.ash '#dcd5c8', which matches the official photos (B-R -5..-12).

issues.evidence: roomCard is called only in the O branch; the O monument end still uses radius 0.012.

issues.detail: (lighting area, not scored) Charcoal parts get a cool blue cast
issues.problem: Shell, band and cap render B-R +18..+23 against +5..+9 in c_27312/27313, although the jShell material is only +11. The same light shifts the ash from -20 to -6. This makes the whole cabin read bluer than the photos.
issues.fix: For the lighting worker (04_shaders.js/12_scene.js): warm the cruise/boarding ambient for the J zone by ~+6 R / -6 B. Do not compensate in SEATMAT.

questions: The pillow in tpg_72 (bed, night light) renders as light as the duvet, but it is far darker than the seat in tpg_42 and omaat_room_15 (daylight). Should the seat-mode pillow follow the daylight photos (proposed #3c4690) and accept a darker pillow in bed mode too?
Is the uncommitted back-piping edit in 09c_room.js meant for this round? It postdates all w7 renders.
